help.stock: Name this stock and enter its supplier, received date, and stock expenses.
help.products: Choose a product category first, then record the products received in that category. Tunakuza manages SKU identity automatically.
help.catalog: Record products by product category while Tunakuza manages SKU identity automatically.
help.record: Record the stock received. A product configuration such as color and capacity stays together while each physical item keeps its own identifier.
help.review: Check the stock information and all recorded product lines, then save a draft or receive the stock.
help.familyAssignment: Product category groups related versions of the same product. Different configurations can have different SKUs and Website prices while remaining in one category.
help.autoSku: Record what makes this product configuration different. Tunakuza will reuse a matching SKU or create the needed SKU automatically when the stock is saved.
help.existingSku: Choose this when the exact product configuration already exists in this category. Tunakuza will use its existing SKU automatically.
help.existingCategory: Choose a product category you already use, then add an existing product or record another configuration in it.
help.newCategory: Create the product category first, then record the product configuration you received.

validation.catalogRequired: Add at least one product to this stock.
validation.conversionPositive: Enter a conversion greater than zero.
validation.familyName: Enter the new product category name.
